info.title: Health Claim Exchange APIs
info.description: The Health Claims Exchange (HCX) is a digital infrastructure designed to enable automated, data-driven management of health insurance claims in an open ecosystem. These API specifications enable all actors to interact with the HCX.

code.description: error code from the system - expected to be namespaced for better readability

ErrorResponse.description: This is a response to the ClaimForm API call

timestamp.description: Unix timestamp when the response is sent.

linked_registry_codes.description: Identifier of the participant in other registries. Each identifier shall be in a “normalised” notation having the structure “identifier@registry”, where registry is a unique code for the registry system and identifier is the unique id of the participant in that registry system. e.g. - facility001@hfr, to link the provider record to HFR record. The list of supported registry codes (e.g. hfr, rohini, etc) should be a configuration at the HCX instance level.

participant_name.description: Human readable name for the participant

scheme_code.description: name/code of the scheme provided by the payor. scheme_code is mandatory for all participants with role “payer”. If the payer wishes to use a single entry for all its schemes, the scheme_code value should be set to “default”.

roles.description: Roles assigned to the participant as per the definition in the domain specifications. This will be used for access control.

address.description: Physical address of the facility including its geolocation

primaryEmail.description: Primary email id for claims related communication.

additionalEmail.description: Additional/alternative email ids of the participant. Maximum of 3 email addresses are allowed.

phone.description: Landline numbers of the provider. Maximum of 3 landline numbers are allowed.

primaryMobile.description: Primary mobile number for claims related communication.

additionalMobile.description: Additional/alternate mobile numbers of the participant.

endpoint_url.description: Default endpoint to make API calls

payment_details.description: Default payment details (UPI or A/C Number + IFSC Code)
